description: The frozen RFC 9266 tls-exporter parameters that generate SCRAM -PLUS channel-binding data. Pinned as data so the Rust client's TLS_EXPORTER_LABEL/TLS_EXPORTER_LEN and the Go server's ExporterLabel/ExporterLen are each checked against one published contract rather than against a comment in the other repository.

cases.description: The exporter label and output length every Myne -PLUS handshake uses. A divergence in either value makes both sides derive different cbind_data, so the client proof fails and no -PLUS handshake can complete — a total, silent authentication break rather than a degraded one. Hex-encoded so whitespace or a homoglyph in the label cannot survive an edit unnoticed.
